sources.title: Genie 3 (DeepMind blog)
sources.role: Discovery-bounded source used for factual verification

claims.text: Real-time 24fps/720p interactive worlds from text prompts with minutes-scale consistency and 1-min visual memory; promptable world events (weather/objects/characters); recent SIMA version executed in Genie-3 worlds to test compatibility for future training (Genie 3 goal-unaware, simulates future from agent actions); Genie 1/2 lineage named; research-preview gating.
claims.context: Official blog consumed in full 2026-09-30 (Aug 5, 2025 post).

claims.text: Five vendor-stated limitations: limited agent action space; multi-agent interaction unsolved; no georeferenced real locales; conditional text rendering; minutes-scale duration. NeRF/3DGS contrast is vendor framing — attributed, not adopted.
Role cap: CAPABILITY + DEPLOYMENT-pointer ONLY; no paper/weights means never ARCHITECTURE_CASE.
claims.context: Edition-level analytical synthesis by the Work operator (lineage/selection/boundary/contract judgment, not a literal statement of the cited source); structural home for edition rationale.

limitations.text: Architecture undisclosed; consistency/SIMA claims vendor-stated; no independent dynamics-use eval (G02).
limitations.context: Evidence boundary retained for downstream editorial use.

targets.finding: Full blog consumed: capabilities, SIMA use, limitations, gating verified as vendor statements.
Vendor-measured claims isolated with explicit attribution and role caps; no independent-evaluation inference performed.
